test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 28 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
A dice has letters M, Q, R, S, T and V on its sides. Two different positions of the same dice are shown below. Select the letter that will be on the face opposite to the one having V.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/29b10d57f82dfdd5a44bf05aea2d2195142b85c62580a18e573dd931c4b9f670.png]
solution:
To find the opposite surface of V, we need to compare the common surface on the given dice.

Now, symbol M is given in Dice 1 and Dice 2

So, from Dice 1 & Dice 2

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0a89f6c65dba13ee40d641ee9d08928386f20ab5224c4f2b68d8a2021e698c13.png] 

→M is the common surface and, R , Q and T are the adjacent surface.

So, **S will be on the opposite side of V.**

Hence the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
